questions.question: Starting from the blue ball hopper with the solved board configuration, describe the complete path of the first blue ball.
questions.answer: The first blue ball drops from (2, -1), rolls onto ramp_right at (3, 0), then ramp_right at (4, 1), then ramp_right at (5, 2), then ramp_right at (6, 3), then ramp_right at (7, 4), then ramp_right at (8, 5), then ramp_left at (9, 6), then ramp_right at (8, 7), then ramp_left at (9, 8), then ramp_right at (8, 9), and is caught at the right exit.

questions.question: Which lever does the first blue ball trigger and what color ball is released next?
questions.answer: The first blue ball triggers the right lever, releasing a red ball.

questions.question: How many balls total are released in what order?
questions.answer: 9 balls reach an exit in the order: blue exits right, red exits right, red exits right, red exits right, red exits right, red exits right, red exits right, red exits right, red exits right. 0 exit left, 9 exit right, 0 are intercepted.
